dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: When I was out gathering materials previously, I heard that some purple, crystalline ores were discovered nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: I wouldn't call them equal to Jade Steel, but they have their uses, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: If I remember right, they should be around here. I've marked them on your map now, so if you do need them, go have a look.
